Docs routes must remain lighter than marketing to preserve search and findability speed. Cap widened 300000→302000 on 2026-08-17 (user decision) after the tightest non-grandfathered route sat at exactly 300000B, dominated by shared shell (fonts 159KB + JS vendor 121KB + CSS 4KB + images 6KB). Widened again 302000→304000 on 2026-08-17 (user decision) after Phase 4 slices 5-8 pushed the tightest route to 301,931 with 69B headroom, byte-blocking D06 graph-execution flagship topology and further shell-affecting slices in Phase 4/M01. The additional +2KB earns ~2KB shared-shell headroom to complete authored-screen enrichments and Phase 6 macros without another shrink obligation. See docs/decisions/docs-performance-baselines.md for the widen rationale.

Raised from 120000 on 2026-08-16: the first real content root (ariadnev 1.0.0, 103-skill catalog plus the generated CLI reference) measured 124960 bytes compressed; 160000 keeps ~28% headroom without indexing less than the reference the reader searches for.
